name: stefs-plugins
description: Stef's Claude Code plugins — the portable layer of software and project architecture conventions and of HTTP/JSON API conventions, plus general-purpose utilities.

plugins.name: arc-conventions
plugins.description: Ten skills carrying the portable layer of a project's software and project architecture conventions: how conventions themselves are recorded, plus SPA frontends, Terraform/AWS infrastructure, Go and Node Lambdas, MySQL, documentation, the glossary, the staged plan of action a proposal becomes, and product requirements. Every skill is model-invoked on topic match; the plugin registers no hooks and adds no executable code.

plugins.name: api-conventions
plugins.description: One skill carrying the portable layer of HTTP/JSON API conventions, written for the human calling the API first: general design principles, resource and field naming (snake_case throughout), the response envelope, list endpoints with search, filtering, sorting and pagination, the error format, methods and status codes, idempotency, versioning and breaking changes, and auth and rate limiting. Query-string arrays are always repeated name[] parameters, never comma-separated strings. Model-invoked on topic match; the plugin registers no hooks and adds no executable code.

plugins.name: utils
plugins.description: General-purpose utility commands, skills and agents for Claude Code, including the default-on auto-summary-commit workflow: a pair of hooks commits the prompt and its summary at the end of every turn that changed files, scoped to the paths that turn actually changed.
